rule: Successful Pump.fun create. Live mode enrolls block times inside the frozen 7-day UTC window. Fixture mode uses the fixture window.
Live T0 is the first time the creation is decoded. T24, T48 and T72 are block_time plus 24h, 48h and 72h and cannot start earlier. Checkpoints: T0, T24, T48, T72. Fixture T0 uses block_time.
Public http(s) URI is requested on IPv4. ipfs:// and ar:// keep the original URI and record the gateway route. Local and private hosts are not collected. Failures are retried.
